summary.text: Jim Olsen was elected to the Oklahoma House of Representatives in 2018 and represents House District 2.

paragraphs.text: Olsen earned an associate of arts degree from Nassau Community College and a Bachelor of Arts degree from the University at Albany, SUNY, and graduated from the Free Gospel Bible Institute.
He and his wife, Becky, have seven children and 10 grandchildren, and he teaches Sunday school at Watts Holiness Church in Sallisaw.
